_meta.title: Services | Gausin International Engineers Pvt. Ltd.
hero.desc.0: From process concept to plant commissioning - Gausin provides comprehensive engineering services that cover every phase of your industrial project lifecycle.
sec.desc.0: Our multi-disciplinary team of engineers delivers specialized services across process design, equipment engineering, project management, energy optimization, and industrial automation.
sec.desc.1: A structured, transparent project delivery process that keeps you informed and in control at every phase.
p.0: From process concept to plant commissioning - Gausin provides comprehensive engineering services that cover every phase of your industrial project lifecycle.
p.1: We begin with an in-depth technical discussion to understand your process requirements, product specifications, capacity targets, utilities available, and project constraints.
p.2: Our process engineers develop mass & energy balances, process simulations, and preliminary equipment sizing to validate technical and commercial feasibility.
p.3: A detailed technical proposal is submitted - including process description, equipment list, P&ID, technical specifications, delivery schedule, and commercial terms.
p.4: Upon order confirmation, detailed engineering commences - 3D CAD design, fabrication drawings, P&ID finalization, structural design, and all engineering deliverables.
p.5: Precision fabrication in our workshop using CNC machining, laser cutting, and TIG/MIG welding - with rigorous quality checks, NDT testing, and third-party inspection.
p.6: Our field engineering team handles site installation, mechanical alignment, piping, electrical connections, pre-commissioning checks, and plant startup with performance testing.
p.7: Guaranteed performance test run conducted in your presence. All documentation, O&M manuals, PLC programs, and as-built drawings handed over upon project completion.
p.8: Ongoing technical support, preventive maintenance, spare parts supply, and annual performance audits to ensure your plant continues operating at peak efficiency.
p.9: Contact our engineering team to discuss your project requirements. We'll respond within 48 hours with a detailed technical and commercial proposal.
card.desc.0: Process engineers, mechanical engineers, instrumentation specialists, project managers, and fabrication experts - all under one roof.
card.desc.1: 48-hour technical proposal response, streamlined engineering processes, and dedicated project managers ensuring on-time delivery.
card.desc.2: All engineering deliverables conform to ASME, PED, BIS, GMP, 3-A, and other applicable national and international standards.
card.desc.3: Every project includes a contractual performance guarantee - we test against specified parameters and stand behind our engineering.
card.desc.4: Comprehensive after-sales service including spare parts, on-site maintenance visits, remote technical support, and annual plant audits.
card.desc.5: World-class engineering quality at competitive Indian pricing - delivering premium international-standard solutions without premium costs.
svc.desc.0: We develop comprehensive process engineering packages for new plants and expansions - including process flowsheets, mass & energy balances, equipment sizing, P&ID development, and process simulation using CHEMCAD and HTRI.
svc.desc.1: Our detailed engineering service covers complete 3D CAD modeling, fabrication drawings, civil structural design, piping layouts, electrical engineering, instrumentation engineering, and procurement specifications for all major equipment and systems.
svc.desc.2: Complete end-to-end project management from concept to commissioning. Our project management team uses MS Project and agile methodologies to ensure on-time, within-budget delivery of complex industrial plants with full documentation and handover.
svc.desc.3: Comprehensive thermal energy audits for existing plants, identifying energy wastage and recommending proven upgrades. We specialize in multi-effect evaporation conversion, TVR (Thermo Vapour Recompressor) / MVR (Mechanical Vapour Recompression) retrofit, and heat recovery integration.
svc.desc.4: We integrate advanced PLC/SCADA automation systems into new and existing process plants - enabling real-time monitoring, automated control sequences, alarm management, data logging, and remote access via IoT-enabled platforms.
svc.desc.5: Our experienced engineers provide expert technical consultancy for process troubleshooting, performance de-bottlenecking, capacity expansion, regulatory compliance, and plant modernization - delivering actionable engineering recommendations with measurable impact.
